intro.title: Can We Help? Let's Run a Check.
intro.subtitle: Answer 4 simple questions. A few seconds are enough to see where your work can become simpler, faster and more automated.
intro.concept: Before we brew your coffee, let's see how much time you're losing.

questions.label: Where does the time go?
questions.microcopy: Let's see where we can lighten the load.
questions.question: In a typical week, how many hours do you estimate your team (or you yourself) spend copying data, filing invoices/receipts or manually entering orders/records from one system to another?

questions.label: HOW FAST DO YOU REPLY?
questions.microcopy: Your time is worth more than a series of clicks.
questions.selectionMicrocopy: A customer shouldn't have to wait while you work.
questions.question: When a customer asks for information, a quote or a service by email/WhatsApp outside business hours or while you're busy, what is the average time before they get a structured reply?

questions.label: What if someone were missing?
questions.question: If the key person who handles your front office, quotes or reception were suddenly away for 10 days, how much would your daily operations suffer?

answers.label: No problem, all processes are automated and documented

questions.label: Where do requests come from?
questions.question: Through how many different channels do customer requests and operational documents reach you today?

answers.label: Single channel: we centralise everything in a dedicated management tool/CRM
2-3 channels: mostly mobile phone calls and office email
Multichannel chaos (4+): owner's WhatsApp, email, social media, calls and scattered notes
Out of control: customers message us privately in the evening or at weekends on personal chats

result.title: Your Coffee Check is ready.
result.subtitle: We've found where your business could win back time, continuity and operating room.
result.nextQuestion: Want to know where to start?

profiles.title: OPERATIONS ALREADY SOLID
profiles.copy: Your operations already seem to have a good structure. The next step could be finding where automation can turn the time you win back into growth.
profiles.quote: When everything works, the right question isn't what to fix, but what to grow.

profiles.title: ROOM TO WIN BACK
profiles.copy: There are repetitive tasks and operational steps that could free up valuable time. This is exactly where a good infrastructure can start to make a difference.
profiles.quote: Lost hours make no noise: you only notice them when you try to count them.

profiles.title: AUTOMATION POTENTIAL
profiles.copy: A significant part of the work still seems to depend on manual tasks, response times or key people. Here automation could have a major impact on business continuity.
profiles.quote: If you stopped tomorrow, what would stop with you? The answer is already a map of your priorities.

bonus.label: On the house
bonus.question: If from next Monday you could magically win back 25% of the time spent on repetitive tasks, what would you invest it in first?

answers.label: Closing more deals / serving more customers

bonus.note: An extra coffee, on the house.
